entities.summary: Correa and the Citizens' Revolution, a transformative movement in Ecuador (2007–2017). Emerged from Yasuní-ITT initiative to leave oil underground — proposed 2007, abandoned 2013. Catalyzed 2008 Constitution — first to recognize rights of nature (Pachamama) and National Assembly.
